entries.title: Shift handover happens at the gate office
entries.text: The harbour shift handover is done at the gate office with a signed paper log.

entries.title: Harbor client retries idempotent calls three times
entries.text: The Harbor ferry client retries an idempotent call three times with exponential backoff, and never retries a booking write.

entries.title: Dock sensor requests time out after eight seconds
entries.text: A dock sensor request that takes longer than eight seconds is abandoned and reported as stale, not as an error.

entries.title: Tide tables are cached for one day
entries.text: Tide tables come from the almanac service and are cached on disk for one day, because the almanac rate-limits per hour.

entries.title: Tide heights round half to even
entries.text: Tide heights are rounded half to even before display, so 2.5 metres shows as 2 and 3.5 as 4.

entries.title: Only one crane operator lock per berth
entries.text: A berth holds at most one crane operator lock. A second request waits, it does not steal the lock, and the lock expires after ninety seconds without a heartbeat.

entries.title: Crane heartbeat drift on the night shift
entries.text: The night shift crane heartbeat drifted by up to four seconds because the controller clock was not synced; the lock expiry still held.

entries.title: Cargo manifest rows carry a container prefix
entries.text: Every cargo manifest row carries a four-letter container prefix and a seven digit serial. A row without both is rejected at import.

entries.title: Importing manifests in one transaction blew the memory budget
entries.text: Importing a whole cargo manifest in one transaction used more than a gigabyte. Stream it in batches of five hundred rows instead.

entries.title: Pilot roster is published every Friday
entries.text: The pilot roster for the coming week is published on Friday at noon local time and is frozen afterwards except for sick cover.

entries.title: A pilot may not exceed twelve hours on duty
entries.text: The scheduler refuses an assignment that takes a pilot past twelve hours on duty in any rolling twenty-four hours.

entries.title: Fuel is recorded in litres, converted once
entries.text: Bunker fuel is recorded in litres. Conversion from tonnes happens once at the edge, using the density on the delivery note.

entries.title: Delivery note density is sometimes missing
entries.text: About one delivery note in forty has no fuel density. The ledger falls back to the supplier default and flags the row for review.

entries.title: Two vessels were booked into the same berth window
entries.text: Two vessels were booked into one berth window because the overlap check compared local times across a daylight saving change. Compare in UTC.

entries.title: Passenger ferries outrank freight at the quay
entries.text: When a quay berth is contested the passenger ferry keeps it and the freight vessel moves to the outer berth.

entries.title: Fog alarms are quiet between midnight and five
entries.text: The fog horn test alarm is silenced between midnight and five in the morning, the real fog alarm is never silenced.

entries.title: Unacknowledged alarms escalate after ten minutes
entries.text: An alarm nobody acknowledges within ten minutes escalates to the harbour master's phone, then to the duty manager after another ten.

entries.title: Channel sixteen is monitored, not used for routine traffic
entries.text: Channel sixteen is monitored for distress calls only. Routine traffic moves to the working channel named in the berth assignment.

entries.title: Radio calls are logged with a vessel callsign
entries.text: Every radio call is logged with the vessel callsign and a UTC timestamp, never with the master's name.

entries.title: Gate badges expire at end of shift
entries.text: A gate badge is valid until the end of the holder's shift and a contractor badge never outlives the contract end date.

entries.title: Gate camera plate reader fails in heavy rain
entries.text: The gate camera plate reader misreads plates in heavy rain; the guard confirms by hand when confidence is below ninety percent.

entries.title: Throughput report closes on the third working day
entries.text: The monthly throughput report closes on the third working day, late manifests are counted in the next month.

entries.title: Throughput is reported in twenty-foot equivalents
entries.text: Throughput is reported in twenty-foot equivalent units, a forty-foot container counts as two.

entries.title: Database backup runs at two in the morning
entries.text: The operations database is backed up at two in the morning and the copy is verified by a test restore every Sunday.

entries.title: A backup restored without the audit table
entries.text: A restore test passed while the audit table was missing, because the verification only counted the cargo tables. Count every table.

entries.title: Shift handover happens at the gate office
entries.text: The harbour shift handover is done at the gate office, and the signed paper log is being replaced by a tablet.
